An early if (!normalise) return; scores 75.7% with the sums in either order. Ruled out: square temporaries, sqrt, powf, __fsqrts and double sqrt variants, signed products, double intermediates, /fp:precise and /fp:strict (either order, worse), /O1, /O2, /Os, #pragma optimize("g", off) (0%), the written order of the sums (/fp:fast reorders them), declaring x before z (worse), testing the stored out[] values, helpers reading out[] (worse), by-value and struct-copy helpers, a length helper in another file (not inlined under /Ob1), a three-component length with y = 0 (loses the fmadds), a conditional expression for inv, swapping the operands of x * inv
